rationale: Matches the status-agnostic single-ID resolution convention already used by every other cli/issues/*.py command with an id-filter branch (check_flag.py, check_design.py, check_verify_verdict.py, and a dozen others), composing existing tested primitives (resolve_issue_path, IssueParser.parse_file) rather than adding a new status-filter code path.
rule: Option A — resolve refine-status's id-filter branch via resolve_issue_path()/_resolve_issue_id() + IssueParser.parse_file(), bypassing find_issues()'s active-only default for that branch
alternatives_rejected: Option B: keep the id-filter branch on find_issues() but pass an explicit status_filter (mirroring find_issues_for_graph()'s precedent) only when issue_id_filter is set — smaller diff but leaves the branch's lookup/error-reporting semantics diverging from sibling commands.
